text:
jordan: Heads-up — Helios just asked to expand the POC. They want streaming responses + BYO-KMS for logs and model keys. Asking if we can keep the original timelines and pricing. :thinking:
amy: Thanks. Do we know why they want streaming? Is it user-facing real-time chat or internal worker pipeline?
devon: Customer says real-time chat with short-turn latency requirements (~100–200ms p95) and strict key control for PII. They're pushing to keep the 3-week POC window.
sara: Streaming + BYO-KMS changes the risk profile. Streaming may need proxying or websocket support on their side; BYO-KMS requires our private deployment or Dedicated with KMS integration. Both add infra work.
jordan: Right — Felipe (Helios) expects no extra cost. Can we outline tradeoffs and a recommended path?
amy: Quick sketch of options: 1) Hosted + streaming proxy (edge websocket) + temporary redact-before-send + host-managed keys — fastest but doesn't meet BYO-KMS. 2) Dedicated trial with KMS integration — meets BYO-KMS, more setup and cost. 3) Hybrid: hosted for functional demo (no KMS) + offline replay to validate encryption flow.
chris: For success criteria we should split infra vs quality: - Latency: p95 <= 250ms for 95% of sessions; - Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent users; - Quality: response accuracy >= 87% on their eval set; - Security: KMS handshake validated in staging.
devon: Pricing note — streaming increases token throughput but reduces tokenization batching efficiency. Dedicated trial setup fee + ~20% uplift on monthly reserved cost for KMS integration maintenance. I'll sync numbers with finance, but high-level: expect a delta of $Xk/month (TBD). :money_with_wings:
jordan: Can we keep the 3-week POC if they accept hybrid/demo route?
sara: Yes for a functional demo (option 1 or hybrid) — set expectations: live demo will not use BYO-KMS; proof of KMS flow will be offline. For full BYO-KMS + streaming in-prod we'd need Dedicated + config time ~4–6 weeks.
amy: Also recommend a tightened eval prompt set to detect streaming regressions. Suggest 50 short-turn convo prompts and 20 long-context prompts. Example prompt snippet for the eval harness:
```
# short-turn convo
User: "What's the ETA for my shipment?"
System: <should_asap_response>
```
Use exact-match and semantic-sim thresholds.
chris: Add a rollout plan to success criteria: canary on 10% of traffic, monitor p95, error-rate < 1% over 30m. If regressions show up, rollback to non-streaming endpoint.
devon: Customer will likely push for no-cost change. I'll surface the tradeoffs and a recommended commercial addendum: trial discount but cover Dedicated setup.
jordan: OK — can someone draft the scoping note and updated SOW bullet points I can send Felipe? Need: timeline options, clear pass/fail success criteria, cost delta estimate, and the minimal demo path.
amy: I'll draft the scoping bullets and eval checklist today. Will ping for review. :thumbsup:
sara: I'll document the infra assumptions and the KMS gating checklist.
chris: I'll add the monitoring & rollback playbook and the canary thresholds.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: draft-review-reminder in 24h for thread 1839991234.
jordan: Thanks team — aim to have the email & SOW bullets ready for Monday EOD. :eyes:
